resource: Results returned by one visibility query
allocation_impact: The query returns the nearest 256 in canonical order and never allocates beyond it; the own actor is always one of them.
boundary_tests: max=256: 256 visible entities are all returned
max+1=257: the farthest visible entity in canonical order is excluded
notes: Equals the future MOVE-RL-11 value (D87). Decision section 4.4; #162 comment 5875958040. Wire consumer: VIS-2 WORLD_SPATIAL type 2 (capability 6).
